answer: The voyage multiplier is published, charged in vertex, and summit lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 5 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 1377 identities would post 2822 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
